title: PP 20/2026: UMKM taxpayer scope and transition
summary: The final rate remains 0.5%; PP 20 changes ordinary taxpayer eligibility, exclusions, aggregation, cooperative duration and transitional rights. Existing entities can remain eligible under Article II.

legal_basis.title: PP Nomor 55 Tahun 2022
legal_basis.pinpoint: Final 0,5%; peredaran bruto Rp4,8 miliar; pengecualian OP Rp500 juta; berlaku 20 Desember 2022

legal_basis.title: PP Nomor 20 Tahun 2026
legal_basis.instrument: PP 20/2026, Pasal I angka 3-6 dan Pasal II
legal_basis.pinpoint: Perubahan Pasal 56-58, penghapusan Pasal 59, ketentuan peralihan; diundangkan 22 April 2026

changes.summary: The final rate remains 0.5%; PP 20 changes ordinary taxpayer eligibility, exclusions, aggregation, cooperative duration and transitional rights. Existing entities can remain eligible under Article II.

computation.base_formula: monthly business turnover under Pasal 60, after the cumulative annual Rp500.000.000 excluded portion for individuals only
computation.notes: Exclude individual professional services under Article 56(3)-(4), foreign income taxed abroad, income final-taxed under other rules, and non-tax objects. Article 60 bases tax on monthly business turnover before the specified discounts; the cumulative IDR 500 million annual excluded portion applies to individuals only. Under Article 61 a taxpayer crossing the turnover ceiling during a tax year continues this regime through that year, with ordinary taxation in following years as provided by law. Article 62 allows self-payment or withholding/collection by an appointed payer. A date or filing code does not establish eligibility. PP 20 Article II can affect tax years 2025 and 2026; the resolver only selects the version by instrument commencement, not retrospective entitlement or an as-known-at legal state.

migration_impact.summary: Retain a separate final turnover-tax treatment and the individuals-only cumulative allowance. Resolve eligibility from taxpayer type, registration history, elections, aggregated turnover, excluded income, and transition rules; do not multiply all revenue by a universal percentage.

after.description: PP 20 ordinary entry scope: resident individuals, single-person companies founded by one individual, and cooperatives; annual turnover limit remains IDR 4.8 billion. Apply Article 57 exclusions including related individual/single-person-company aggregate turnover, specialist-service single-person companies, elections, specified incentives and permanent establishments. Cooperatives have a four-tax-year limit. Article 58 aggregates the specified business/professional, foreign, spouse and related single-person-company turnover; do not test a single entity in isolation. Article 59 is deleted. Article II preserves grandfather eligibility for existing CV/firms, other limited companies and BUM Desa until their prior periods expire, and provides specific 2025/2026 and cooperative transition relief. Do not infer immediate exclusion of every existing entity from the new-entry list.

before.description: Original PP 55 scope: resident individuals and eligible cooperatives, CV, firms, limited companies, BUM Desa/BUM Desa bersama, with annual turnover not exceeding IDR 4.8 billion. Article 59 maximum periods are 7 tax years for individuals, 4 for specified entities including single-person companies, and 3 for other limited companies, subject to registration and Article 69 transition rules. Exclude opted-out taxpayers, qualifying professional CV/firms, specified relief recipients and permanent establishments under Article 57(2).

verification.notes: Rate, statutory commencement and scope checked against DJP-hosted full statute texts. Eligibility is described, not automatically evaluated.

notes: Instrument commencement is encoded. PP 20 Article II includes relief affecting tax years 2025 and 2026; these retrospective eligibility decisions are not a date-only resolver computation.
